hooks.name: walkthrough-before-demo-claim
hooks.description: After the haunted demo or the walkthrough script changes, remind the agent to run the transcript before claiming the demo works.

action.prompt: Do not claim the haunted demo works until python3 scripts/demo_walkthrough.py exits 0. The transcript must show question, answer, quote span, and pass/fail for both eob-explainer and lease-checker. Also run python3 evals/run_evals.py and python3 -m pytest. Follow .kiro/steering/haunted-demo.md. The demo is synthetic, not a medical device, and not legal advice.
